name: 네페르
silhouette: 거대한 원형 후광, 머리 뒤로 떠다니는 마법 파편들, 펼쳐진 빛의 날개, 길게 뻗은 태양의 창
signature_motion: 공중으로 떠올라 빛의 창을 지면에 내리꽂는 돌진
signature_vfx: 바닥에서 솟구치는 눈부신 금색 빛의 거대한 파동
visual_en: A small 2-head tall divine figure facing right. The head features glowing golden eyes without pupils and flowing platinum white hair. Behind the head floats a massive, dazzling golden halo-like aura. Floating magical fragments of bright orange light orbit the body. The character wears a deep teal priestly robe adorned with intricate gold embroidery and a small light ring above the head. Large, shimmering wings of pure white light spread from the back. The character holds a long, radiant sun spear made of brilliant gold and white light. Around the ankles, small glowing golden ornaments shine. The overall silhouette is defined by the large circular halo and the sharp, bright spear.
pose_en: Hovering majestically with a commanding presence.
vfx_en: A massive expanding wave of brilliant gold and white light.
lore: 마지막 스테이지(천상)의 최종 보스. 장판이 더 넓고 졸개를 자주 부른다. 돌진·탄막·장판·소환.
